jobs.title: Brownfields Program Coordinator - West
jobs.description:
Toeroek Associates, Inc. is seeking a **Brownfields Program Coordinator to** coordinate all phases of Targeted Brownfields Assessments in the western U.S. The successful candidate will provide comprehensive coordination of up to ten concurrent Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments, supporting a team that assesses the nature and extent of contamination at Brownfields sites.


Periodic travel of up to 25% is required. Worksite locations are distributed across the western United States, including Hawaii and Alaska. Candidates must be geographically located within reasonable proximity of West Coast states in order to support operations and facilitate fieldwork.

**Duties include**

* Provide comprehensive coordination of logistics, staffing, reporting, and deliverables across multiple active sites.
* Oversee project managers, including cost estimates, work schedules, and staff assignments to maintain on\-time and on\-budget performance.
* Provide oversight to field staff and subcontractors conducting site investigation and remediation projects for approximately 15 field sites located in the West region.
* Ensure that project deliverables, milestones, and budgets are met.
* Work closely with senior managers in the coordination of work activities to meet milestones, budgetary limits, deadlines, or other performance indicators.
* Communicate professionally and effectively with government customers and project partners.
* Prepare, review, and submit well\-written technical reports in accordance with regulations, applicable guidance and policies, and internal quality control standards.
* Conduct Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments (ESAs).
* Lead field activities, including soil, groundwater, sediment, and soil gas sample collection; geological logging and interpretation; and oversight of investigation and remediation subcontractors, including laboratories and excavation and drilling companies
* Support providing soil and groundwater assessments, soil gas sampling, asbestos inspections, lead\-based paint assessments, geophysical surveys, and waste determinations
* Prepare technical reports and other documents on topics associated with site characterization, remedial optimization, and remedy implementation
* Recognize technical discrepancies in analytical results and making appropriate corrections following standard procedures
* Provide support in organizing public meetings to address the findings of ESAs

**Required Education/Experience**


BS degree in Engineering, Geology, Environmental Science, or related field with four years of practical experience related to environmental field sampling and two years as a field\-team lead. Preferred work experience with contaminated site characterization and remediation at contaminated sites, including Superfund, Brownfields, or RCRA Corrective Action sites. Strong knowledge of federal and state environmental laws and regulations under Federal (e.g., Superfund, RCRA, Brownfields), state, or other cleanup programs. Experience with Phase I and Phase II ESAs and experience conducting quantitative analyses using Microsoft Excel

**REQUIRED CREDENTIALS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* 40\-Hour HAZWOPER

**PROFESSIONAL SKILLS:**

* Demonstrated attributes to become a strong consultant team player, eagerness to learn and grow, self\-starter who takes the initiative, versatile, and service\-oriented
* Effective written/verbal communication and organization/analytical skills; experience writing and compiling technical data and reports
* Ability to multitask, maintain flexibility, travel, and work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once


The anticipated hiring salary range for this remote position is $75,000\-140,000 DOQ. Pay consideration is given based on geographic location, relevant work experience, and education. Toeroek offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, Life, LTD, STD, and 401 (k). Qualified applicants should include their resume with their completed application for further consideration.


Toeroek Associates is a dynamic small business provider of specialty consulting and analysis services to the U.S. Government. Toeroek offers a collaborative and congenial work environment with a team of passionate staff dedicated to finding solutions to complex problems in the fields of environment, records and knowledge management, and national security. Our multi\-disciplined environmental staff includes scientific, legal, and engineering experts who support federal and state government entities in compliance, removal and remediation, field services, site assessments, oversight, historical and technical research, litigation, cost recovery, and community engagement.




Toeroek Associates, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer.

*Toeroek Associates, Inc. maintains the policy of equal employment opportunity (EEO) shall apply to all terms, conditions, and privileges of employment, including hiring, testing, training and development, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, educational assistance, termination, layoffs, social and recreational programs, and retirement. Toeroek is committed to making employment decisions based on valid requirements, without regard to age, color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other applicable status protected by state or local law.*

*Applicants with disabilities may contact Toeroek Associates, Inc., Human Resources via telephone, fax, e\-mail, and other means to request and arrange for accommodations. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, you may request accommodation at any time. Please contact Human Resources at hr@toeroek.com.*

jobs.description:
**The Position**
----------------

  

  

**Turn Data Into Impact**
The City of Encinitas is seeking a motivated and collaborative GIS Analyst I to support the City's Enterprise Geographic Information System (GIS) and help transform data into meaningful information that improves City services. This position develops and maintains geospatial data, creates maps, dashboards, and web applications, performs spatial analysis, and provides GIS support to departments across the organization. The ideal candidate is customer\-focused, detail\-oriented, and eager to learn emerging GIS technologies while helping solve real\-world challenges through innovative geospatial solutions.  

If you're ready to map your future, this might be the perfect opportunity \- Apply today!!!
**Examples of Important \& Essential Duties (included but not limited to)**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------


**Essential Duties****:** (These duties are a representative sample; position assignments may vary.)  

1\. Manages assigned GIS requests and projects from City staff and, as appropriate, the public; interprets and identifies appropriate data and tools, completes assignments, and prepares related documentation.  

2\. Creates, edits, maintains, analyzes, and visualizes geographic and tabular data; performs data conversion, geocoding, data integration, and routine spatial analysis.  

3\. Produces professional\-quality maps, exhibits, web maps, dashboards, reports, and other cartographic and data visualization products.  

4\. Assists with the implementation, configuration, testing, upgrade, and maintenance of GIS software, applications, services, and integrations.  

5\. Maintains and quality controls (Quality Controls) GIS datasets, feature services, web maps, and related content in accordance with established data standards and business requirements.  

6\. Provides technical support, instruction, and basic training to City staff in the use of GIS applications, web mapping tools, mobile GIS, dashboards, and related technologies.  

7\. Assists with integrating GIS data and applications with enterprise business systems, databases, asset management, permitting, work order, document management, and other City systems.  

8\. Creates and maintains metadata, data dictionaries, documentation, data standards, and GIS procedures to support data quality, transparency, and reuse.  

9\. Uses and supports field data collection technologies, including mobile GIS applications, GPS/GNSS devices, and related equipment, as assigned.  

10\. Assists with business process analysis and identifies opportunities to improve City services and internal workflows through GIS, automation, data visualization, and spatial analysis.  

11\. Researches emerging GIS technologies, functionality, and industry best practices and assists with evaluating and implementing appropriate solutions.  

12\. Supports other applications as assigned, such as the City website or intranet.  

12\. Performs other duties of a similar nature or level.  

  

**Positions assigned to level I may be responsible for:**  

* Fulfills daily staff and citizen requests, such as map, data and mailing requests;
* Creates, edits, and maintains GIS data and assists with data quality control;
* Creates maps, web maps, dashboards, and other GIS products using established standards and templates;
* Assists with mobile GIS data collection and field verification;
* Assists in implementing, testing, and upgrading GIS software and applications;
* Creates and maintains metadata and documentation;
* Provides basic GIS support and instruction to City staff and learns City GIS standards, procedures, and workflows;
* Provide basic support and account management for other IT applications, such as the City website, as needed.

 **Knowledge of:** Esri ArcGIS Pro and familiarity with web\-based GIS concepts; Cartographic principles and map design; Geographic concepts, coordinate systems, projections, and spatial data structures; GIS concepts, principles, and practices; Mobile GIS and GPS/GNSS data collection principles; GIS data creation, editing, conversion, quality assurance, and quality control; Geospatial and relational database concepts and data management principles; Spatial analysis and geoprocessing methods; Basic programming or scripting concepts. **Skills in:** Using computers and current software applications, including Microsoft 365 and GIS\-related technologies; Performing spatial analysis and geoprocessing; Producing accurate, clear, and professional maps and cartographic products; Managing and quality controlling spatial and tabular data; Using GIS software to create, edit, maintain, analyze, and visualize geographic data; Troubleshooting basic GIS issues; Learning and applying GIS standards, procedures, and new technologies; Gathering, compiling, interpreting, and presenting geographic information; Communicating technical information clearly and professionally to coworkers, supervisors, City staff, consultants, and the public; Providing responsive and effective customer service; Establishing priorities, managing multiple assignments, meeting deadlines, and working effectively both independently and collaboratively.  

**Knowledge of the following is desirable:**  

* ArcGIS Online
* ArcGIS Enterprise
* Survey123
* Field Maps
* Experience Builder
* Dashboards
* Python
* SQL
* REST services
* Asset management or work management systems
* AI\-assisted workflows and automation

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


**Training and Experience**:  

Bachelor’s Degree in Geography, Computer Science or a related field, and two years of professional level GIS experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job such as those listed above.  

  

Experience with Esri ArcGIS Pro is required. Experience with ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, mobile G

### **Job Description and Duties**


Under the direction of the Nutria Eradication Operations Supervisor, the incumbent will serve as one of the lead field scientists for the Nutria Eradication Program. Nutria are highly invasive and extremely detrimental to the environment, but primarily nocturnal and relatively elusive in low densities. This position will play a critical role in the coordination of field crews conducting nutria surveys and trapping across the southern portion of the nutria infestation. The incumbent will assist the Operations Supervisor with training, leading, and evaluating field crew technicians and scientific aides to survey for, detect, and remove nutria, with the ultimate goal of eradicating nutria from the State of California. The incumbent will lead the team by example in conducting habitat suitability assessments, visual observation and camera surveys, trapping, and electronic data collection (i.e., ESRI Field Maps smartphone application), as well as effective use of baits and lures and obtaining entry permits from local landowners. The incumbent is responsible for conducting morning briefings of the assigned crew, tracking daily spatial assignments, and ensuring field staff understand understand project protocols. The incumbent will work with the Operations Supervisors, other field crew leads, and Planning Specialist to evaluate and help refine detection and trapping methods and tools for the most effective and efficient detection and removal of nutria. The incumbent will also closely coordinate with other regions and Department functions, as well as other affected and involved local, State, and Federal agencies. Work includes preparing draft reports and correspondence and answering routine questions from the public relative to Departmental nutria efforts. The primary geographical focus of this position will be in Fresno, Madera, Merced, Stanislaus, Tuolumne, Kings, Kern, and Mariposa counties, but work may be assigned in any part of the area of nutria infestation. This position is physically demanding, but highly rewarding given the ultimate accomplishment of protecting California's wetlands, waterways, infrastructure, and agriculture from the devastation nutria have caused in other regions of North America.
Incumbent must be willing and able to competently use firearms as per the Department’s Policy for Non\-Enforcement Personnel. Must be willing and able to competently use and possess wildlife restraint drugs and equipment. Must wear a Department uniform.  

  

  

**Personal Leave Program:** Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary salary reductions ranging from 2% to 4\.62% in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) hours. Please note that the salary ranges listed in this Job Control may not reflect these reductions associated with the 2025 Personal Leave Program.  

Please follow the link for more information regarding the 2025 Personal Leave program:  

Personal Leave Program \- Human Resources \- CalHR.  

  

  

Link to Environmental Scientist Exam: CalCareers  

  

  

**This position is a 12\-month Limited Term (LT) and may be extended up to 24 months or become permanent.**  

  

During this 12\-month Limited Term assignment, you will receive full health, dental, and vision benefits! You will also earn State Service and accrue monthly leave credits.  

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.


### **Working Conditions**


Must be willing to work atypical hours and on weekends. Some overnight travel may be required (up to 5%). Must be able to swim, walk through deep mud and thick vegetation, work on steep or uneven terrain, in extreme weather and under physically challenging conditions. Must be willing and able to competently use pellet pistols or firearms as per the Department’s Policy for Non\-Enforcement Personnel. Willing to handle live animals and carcasses, dispatch animals, and conduct simple tissue sampling and necropsies. Must possess valid Driver's License and be able to safely and effectively operate watercraft and and Utility Task Vehicles (UTV)s, as well as tow trailers. This job requires daily operation of State vehicles to reach field sites, regular use of kayaks, and occasional operation of UTVs and motorized watercraft. Must wear Department uniform. Must be willing and able to obtain a California Boater Card and other motorboat operator certifications as determined necessary.  

  

  

The primary geographical focus of this position will be in Fresno, Madera, Merced, Stanislaus, Tuolumne, Kings, Kern, and Mariposa counties, but work may be assigned in any part of the area of nutria infestation.
  

This is a 12\-month limited\-term position but may be extended to 24 months based on performance and availability of funding.

jobs.title: Lead Operations Geologist
jobs.description:
Description:  



**Role** \- The Lead Operations Geologist provides technical and organizational leadership across pre\-drill planning, real\-time drilling operations, and post\-well evaluation. The successful candidate will manage geosteering personnel and contractors, establish clear operating standards, and ensure that geologic interpretations are translated into timely, practical recommendations for drilling operations.


The main responsibilities will be to integrate subsurface interpretation, well planning, drilling data, and operational constraints. The Lead Operations Geologist will work closely with asset geologists, drilling engineers, drill\-site personnel, reservoir engineering, completions, land, regulatory, and other subsurface disciplines to support safe, efficient, and technically sound well delivery.

**Responsibilities**

**Geosteering Leadership**

* Lead daily geosteering activities, staffing, coverage, priorities, and escalation protocols.
* Review real\-time interpretations, landing recommendations, directional targets, and operational communications.
* Provide technical guidance during uncertain or rapidly changing drilling conditions.
* Mentor personnel and improve team capabilities, workflows, reporting, and quality control.
* Ensure recommendations are technically supported, clearly communicated, and properly documented.

**Pre\-Drill Geologic Planning**

* Manage geologic deliverables required to prepare wells and pads for drilling.
* Develop geologic prognosis packages, including formation tops, targets, landing strategies, structural interpretations, offset correlations, risks, and uncertainties.
* Integrate logs, seismic, core, mudlogs, geochemistry, petrophysics, production, and offset\-well data.
* Coordinate geologic inputs for directional plans, bottom\-hole locations, target lines, and landing points.
* Support pilot\-hole, logging, coring, mudlogging, and sampling programs.

**Real\-Time Operations Support**

* Provide operational geology oversight from spud through total depth, with particular focus on curve and lateral execution.
* Integrate real\-time drilling parameters, directional surveys, logging\-while\-drilling data, mudlogs, gas data, cuttings descriptions, and offset\-well information.
* Review proposed directional targets and significant interpretation changes before they are communicated to the drilling team.
* Maintain close communication with drill\-site managers, drilling engineers, asset geologists, mudloggers, geosteerers, and other operational personnel.

**Post\-Well Evaluation and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead post\-well reviews and finalize geosteering interpretations.
* Track performance measures related to placement, interpretation quality, and operational efficiency.
* Maintain standardized procedures, templates, technical documentation, and data\-quality practices.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary interface between geosteering, geoscience, drilling, and operations.
* Balance reservoir objectives with directional constraints, operational risk, and drilling efficiency.
* Communicate interpretations, uncertainties, recommendations, and business implications to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Support broader development, appraisal, and operational initiatives as needed.


Requirements:

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Geoscience, Geophysics, or a related discipline.
* 10 or more years of oil and gas geoscience experience, including operations geology and geosteering.
* Experience supporting unconventional horizontal\-well development.

**Skills \& Attributes**

* Strong knowledge of pre\-drill planning, landing strategy, well correlation, structural interpretation, and real\-time well placement.
* Ability to integrate geologic, petrophysical, directional, and drilling data in real time.
* Experience leading or mentoring geosteering personnel or other technical professionals.
* Advanced proficiency with geosteering and subsurface interpretation software.
* Strong communication, organizational, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple active wells and make timely recommendations with incomplete or evolving information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Geology, Geoscience, Geophysics, or a related discipline.
* Powder River Basin, Rockies, or comparable multi\-zone unconventional experience.
* Experience utilizing data visualization and analytics platforms (Spotfire, Power BI, Python, SQL, or similar) to evaluate drilling, geosteering, completion, and production datasets
* Demonstrated ability to identify trends, develop performance metrics, and translate large subsurface datasets into actionable recommendations that improve well placement, drilling execution, and development outcomes
* Advanced experience with StarSteer and multi\-well geosteering workflows.
* Experience with GeoGraphix, Spotfire, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing operations geology procedures and quality\-control workflows.
* Experience planning and evaluating logging, coring, mudlogging, and geochemical programs.
* Demonstrated record of improving team capability, or well\-delivery performance.

**Working Conditions**

* Predominantly office\-based, with occasional travel to drilling locations and field operations.
* Regular interaction with field personnel and remote operations teams.
* Availability outside normal business hours is required when operational activity or escalation needs warrant.
* Participation in an on\-call or operational coverage schedule may be required.
* Some travel may occur with limited notice.
